svg.title: AI SDLC Orchestrator — detailed workflow
svg.desc: Discovery, Business Refinement and Functional Analysis feed independent horizontal Engineering and QA tracks. Engineering proceeds through Technical Design, Implementation Planning, Development and Code Review, Engineering Verification, Security Review and Final Verification. QA proceeds through Test Strategy and Scenarios, Test Automation and QA Verification. Human approval and advancement remain separate decisions; the detailed view expands paired checkpoints. Current completed QA evidence is required before Engineering advances from Verification to Security. QA automation requires approved Design interfaces; execution binds current approved implementation and automation. Final Verification uses current Engineering outputs and QA evidence. Both tracks end at Verified, not Released. Advancement does not start work.
svg.metadata: Visual reference: complete-workflow-v2-r1 master-scene.svg; SHA-256 d207b0f0fbd568660d801130f2be59959fb6760a90cfde52136ec32f95dd9c00. Generated by docs/assets/generate_workflow.py; runtime-aligned activity overview, not a full state chart.

g.text: One shared path. Two independently governed work tracks.

g.title: Discovery
Complete Discovery; a distinct human decision
Business Refinement
Approve Business revision; a distinct human decision
Advance Business; a distinct human decision
Functional Analysis
Approve Analysis revision; a distinct human decision

g.data-gate: Advance Analysis and create track readiness
g.title: Advance Analysis and create track readiness; a distinct human decision
Technical Design
Approve Design revision; a distinct human decision
Advance Design; a distinct human decision
Implementation Planning
Approve Plan revision; a distinct human decision
Advance Plan to Development readiness; a distinct human decision
Development / Code Review
Approve Code Review revision; a distinct human decision
Advance Code to Verification; a distinct human decision
Engineering Verification

g.data-gate: Advance Verification with current completed QA evidence
g.title: Advance Verification with current completed QA evidence; a distinct human decision
Security Review

g.data-gate: Advance after current Security Review and resolved findings
g.title: Advance after current Security Review and resolved findings; a distinct human decision
Final Verification
Explicitly finalize Engineering; a distinct human decision
Engineering Verified
Test Strategy / Scenarios
Approve strategy and scenarios; a distinct human decision
Advance QA design; a distinct human decision
Test Automation
Approve QA automation; a distinct human decision
Advance QA to Verification readiness; a distinct human decision
QA Verification

g.data-gate: Explicitly complete QA after current passing checks
g.title: Explicitly complete QA after current passing checks; a distinct human decision
QA Verified

g.text: Automation needs approved Design interfaces; QA execution binds current approved implementation and automation.
Paired shields: approve the revision, then separately advance. Discovery uses explicit completion.
Assignment is not approval. Advancement is not starting work. Independent tracks do not automatically run parallel agents.
